=> < DeviceX | 'key' : K , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Ms) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : D , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
